title: CCC 2026 — official GPX from the HOKA UTMB Mont-Blanc race page
publisher: HOKA UTMB Mont-Blanc / UTMB World Series
claims: The official CCC race page exposes a direct GPX link under pdf.utmb.world; a HEAD request on 2026-11-20 returned HTTP 200 with 1,468,412 bytes.
The GPX metadata names the track CCC 2026, credits LiveTrail as creator and carries a LiveTrail copyright line but no redistribution licence.
The file contains 9,064 track points; a local planar calculation gives 99.36 km, with a 3 m elevation threshold giving +6,015 m and −6,199 m between 1,035 m and 2,556 m.
The GPX's 99.36 km is 8.44 km shorter than the official timing table's 107.8 km for the 2026 rerouted course, so the file cannot be treated as the raced 2026 geometry without further confirmation.

verification.checkedVia: official race page HTML + direct GPX download
verification.note: Direct URL extracted from https://montblanc.utmb.world/races/ccc; file downloaded once to a temporary directory, measured locally, then deleted. The file carries a LiveTrail copyright line and no reuse grant.
